rejected_profile.reading: within the rejected set: a gene silent in every cell of the panel is one the four lines cannot make, a tissue they do not cover; a gene another line makes is a wrong-cell case. The honoured set is expressed by definition, so silent_in_every_cell is 0 there and is not a comparison

evidence.expression: experimental: ENCODE total RNA-seq signal over the canonical exons, per strand
evidence.promoter: experimental: ENCODE DNase-seq peak within 1 kb of the TSS (the reader)
evidence.elements: predicted: AlphaGenome deletion target and magnitude, active where a DNase peak overlaps
